items.title: Our Newmont Stock Pick Still Glitters After 66% Gains. Stay Bullish.
items.summary: Newmont Corp  has returned 66% in the year since we recommended it as a Barron’s stock pick, handily beating out the 30% increase in the  over the period.  For Newmont, the historic rally in precious metals has certainly helped, as the price of gold climbed to a record $5,589 an ounce earlier this year.  Newmont is positioned to continue capitalizing on its sector-leading position with elevated metals prices driving record cash flow and earnings.

items.title: Headwater Gold and Newmont sign earn-in agreement for Jupiter project
items.summary: The agreement allows Newmont to earn up to a 75% stake in Jupiter by spending $30m and providing a pre-feasibility study.
